_note: Synthetic phrasings written for the offline deterministic eval (evaluations/deterministic_eval.py). Written by the developer/AI after the safety gate existed, so it is NOT an independent blind test set. 'core' red flags are the three the brief names (chest pain, fainting, breathlessness); 'extended' are other emergencies.
